_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: God said to Abram, Go — and he went.
We have left the familiar to follow.
The road is long, and we cannot see the end.
But the One who calls us keeps the promise.
Jesus passed the tax booth and said, Follow me.
We rose and came, and we are still coming.
Come, let us worship the God who calls.
We come, and we will go where you send us. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Feel the dust of the road still on your feet — you came from somewhere to be here, and God has been with you the whole way.
Here we are; we will follow.
To Abram, settled and old, God said only one word — Go — and a whole new country opened ahead of him.
Here we are; we will follow.
At the tax booth Jesus stopped, looked Matthew in the eye, and said the same word he says to you: come.
Here we are; we will follow.
He sits down to eat with the ones the world wrote off, and there is a place at that table for you.
Here we are; we will follow. Lead on, O God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: God said to Abram, Go, and the road opened.
Here we are; we will follow.
The dust of the journey is still on our feet.
Here we are; we will follow.
Jesus says, as he said at the tax booth, Follow me.
Here we are; we will follow.
Come, let us worship the God who leads.
Here we are; we will follow. Amen.
